test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the questions. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons good at the given sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e36b7d255a5a828e235f1f70bb79c7293f544a05892b3b31cb6ff3ac1f160653.png] 

How many people are good exactly two sports ?
solution:
According to the given diagram the total number of people who are good at exactly two sports are shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f64e82943ab898d65151cc1fdf3822211ca4678a3a38b4210c05d8dbc9e01f7.png] 

**Thus, as marked above :-**

Total number of people who are good at exactly two sports = Total number of people good at both chess and badminton + Total number of people good at both chess and tennis + Total number of people good at both tennis and badminton

Total number of people who are good at exactly two sports = 14 + 11 + 18

Total number of people who are good at exactly two sports = 43

Hence, **"43"** is the correct answer.
